description: Marketing campaign catalog, one row per campaign (Jul 2023 - Aug 2026). Typed, normalized and checked from workspace.bronze.marketing_campaigns; missing promoted products filled from the campaign code.

load.notes: Single CSV snapshot re-delivered in full. As-of date 2026-06-18. No other table is read.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identifier (CMP-XXXXXXXXXXXX), trimmed and upper-cased. Primary key; referenced by campaign_sends.

campaign_name.description: Campaign code CMP_<objective>_<product>_<MonYYYY of start>_<seq> (e.g. CMP_ACQ_CC_Jan2024_0001); unique. See name_matches_fields.

description.description: Templated description ('Campaña de <objective> para <product>'); NULL for 39 campaigns. Carries no information beyond objective and product.

promoted_product.description: FIX: promoted product type (Spanish, as products.product_type); when not delivered, taken from the product code in campaign_name (10 campaigns). NULL only for general campaigns (code GEN, 12).

promoted_product_raw.description: Promoted product as delivered (canonical casing); NULL for 22 campaigns.

promoted_product_en.description: Canonical English product type of promoted_product (same vocabulary as products.product_type_en).

promoted_product_imputed.description: FLAG: promoted_product was filled from campaign_name because it was not delivered.

target_segment.description: Targeted customer segment; NULL = no restriction (79 campaigns). Decorative: sends are not restricted to it.

target_country.description: Targeted country, canonical name without accents; NULL = all countries (111 campaigns). Decorative: sends reach every country whatever the target.

target_country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of target_country; NULL when there is no target.

end_date.description: Campaign end date (planned; runs up to 2026-08, after the as-of date).

budget.description: Campaign budget; currency not stated in the source. NULL for 31 campaigns.

campaign_status.description: Campaign status (current state, no timestamp). 3 Completed campaigns end after the as-of date (see check status_matches_dates).

expected_conversion_rate.description: Expected conversion rate in percent (0.55-14.69); NULL for 14 campaigns.

name_matches_fields.description: FLAG: the objective, product and start month encoded in campaign_name agree with campaign_objective, promoted_product_raw (when delivered) and start_date.

checks.name: name_consistent
checks.description: Objective, product and start month in campaign_name agree with the fields.

checks.name: promoted_product_as_delivered
checks.description: Counts campaigns whose promoted product was filled from the code (FIX applied).

checks.name: end_not_before_start
checks.expr: start_date IS NULL OR end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date
checks.description: The campaign ends on or after its start.

checks.name: status_matches_dates
checks.expr: CASE campaign_status WHEN 'Completed' THEN end_date < DATE '2026-06-18' WHEN 'Active' THEN start_date <= DATE '2026-06-18' AND end_date >= DATE '2026-06-18' ELSE true END
checks.description: Completed campaigns ended before the as-of date 2026-06-18; Active ones are running on it.

checks.name: target_country_known
checks.expr: target_country IS NULL OR target_country_code IS NOT NULL
checks.description: A delivered target country maps to MX, CO or AR.
